# Fixes

- **Usage statistics now include servers in safe mode.** bStats previously started only after every startup check passed, so new installs, servers missing Towny or DiscordSRV, and every first start after upgrading from 1.0.x were never counted. 1.1.1 servers did not appear on bStats at all. Statistics now start before any check that can enter safe mode.
- **New town and nation roles are created with no permissions.** Discord copies the `@everyone` role's permissions to a new role when none are given, so roles created by earlier versions carried those permissions. Access to town and nation channels now comes only from the channels' own permission overrides.
- **Clearer dependency errors.** When both Towny and DiscordSRV are missing, both are reported, each on its own `[DEPENDENCY]` line, and the Towny message names the minimum version (0.97.5.0).

# Changelog

**Added**
- Five anonymous bStats charts: plugin status (running, waiting for Discord, storage migration, or the general safe-mode cause), storage type, Towny version, DiscordSRV version, and which channel, logging and account-security features are enabled. No player names, Discord IDs, town names or configuration values are sent. Opt out with `enabled: false` in `plugins/bStats/config.yml`.
- Comments in `config.yml` explaining the `TimeZone` and `DateFormat` formats.
- Contributor guide, security policy, and issue and pull request templates.

**Modified**
- On Minecraft 1.16.5, Towny 0.100.3.0 fails to enable on Spigot, CraftBukkit and Purpur because those servers lack libraries it needs. The documentation now recommends Towny 0.100.1.0 for them; Paper 1.16.5 can keep 0.100.3.0.
- Startup and membership planning code were reorganized into smaller, separately tested steps, with no intended change in behavior.

# Compatibility

| Minecraft | Server | Towny | DiscordSRV |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1.16.5 | Paper | 0.100.3.0 | 1.30.5 |
| 1.16.5 | Spigot / CraftBukkit / Purpur | 0.100.1.0 | 1.30.5 |
| 1.17.1, 1.18.2 | Spigot / Paper / Purpur | 0.100.3.0 | 1.30.5 |
| 1.19.4, 1.20.1, 1.20.6 | Paper / Purpur | 0.103.2.0 | 1.30.5 |
| 1.21.1, 1.21.4, 1.21.8, 1.21.10, 1.21.11 | Paper / Purpur | 0.103.2.0 | 1.30.5 |
| 26.1.2, 26.2 | Paper / Purpur, Java 25 | 0.103.2.0 | 1.30.5 |
| 26.3 | Paper / Purpur, Java 25 | 0.103.2.15 (pre-release) | 1.30.5 |

Towny 0.102 and later do not support Spigot or CraftBukkit, so 1.19.4 and newer need Paper or Purpur. Folia is not supported.

# Testing

Before release, every build was started on real Paper, Purpur, Spigot and CraftBukkit servers for all 14 Minecraft versions: on its own, alongside Towny, and alongside DiscordSRV. Role and channel creation, membership grants and revocations, and cleanup were tested against a dedicated Discord test server on Paper 26.3.

# Downloads and upgrade notes

Choose the **JAR matching your Minecraft version**. The optional ZIP includes `config.example.yml`, README, migration instructions and `BUILD-INFO.txt`.

There are no changes to stored database schemas or configuration settings in 1.1.2. When upgrading from 1.1.0 or 1.1.1, replace the JAR and keep `config.yml`. When upgrading from 1.0.x, follow the documented `config.yml.bak` migration and two-start review process.

Existing town and nation roles keep the permissions they were created with. If your `@everyone` role has permissions you do not want town and nation members to keep after you change `@everyone`, clear the permissions on existing `town-` and `nation-` roles in Discord's role settings.

Back up `plugins/TownyDiscordChat/`, your database, and important Discord server settings before upgrading.
